issues.message: CHK-002 userSees may be too abstract (does not contain specific output text in quotes). Should describe the exact text the user sees, not descriptions like "feature works correctly"

3 checklist items; please check for missing combined scenarios (e.g., what happens when Fixture generator core: seeded deterministic corpus emission in the recovery-runner layout + Trap templates: six in-store classes + held-out negative-controls + clean, with per-trap leakage strip list are performed simultaneously?)

missing_original_intent_snapshot: Intent MVP requires original_intent_snapshot_set with sourceText, normalizedOutcome, and acceptanceClaim. This story_review row is advisory only; ProofStory gates consume CLI-written artifacts, not prompt text.

missing_intent_collision: Intent collision is triggered but no pass decision with acceptedInterpretation is present. This story_review row is advisory only; ProofStory gates consume CLI-written artifacts, not prompt text.

missing_red_evidence: Red evidence is triggered but no current red evidence record binds baseline head/material to the correct acceptance target and green relation. This story_review row is advisory only; ProofStory gates consume CLI-written artifacts, not prompt text.

understanding still has 1 undigested unknowns: Exact per-class known-bad realism (how tempting each trap is to a real host) is not measurable in this story — the M6 pilot estimates the actual baseline defect rate; here known-bad only needs to be a VALID instance of the failure mode that the oracle detects.

missing_scope_check: scope-check.json is missing PLAN gate evidence. `scope_check_save` already exists; a lattice-review-scope-plan / scope-plan reviewer must persist the result through `scope_check_save`. The implementation/main agent must not self-sign this evidence or manually edit story metadata. Local CLI guidance is not remote completion and must not be presented as receipt verification or production/full completion.
